title: Reviewing Income Eligibility Thresholds for Financial Assistance Schemes given Cost-of-Living Pressures
what_it_is: Reviewing Income Eligibility Thresholds for Financial Assistance Schemes given Cost-of-Living Pressures

sections.label: ComCare income benchmark and support
sections.summary: The $800 benchmark is indicative, not a qualifying criterion, and ComCare rates are adjusted for inflation, with other support like the Assurance Package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The current gross monthly per capita household income benchmark of $800 and below is an indicative benchmark and not a qualifying criterion.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Families who are above the benchmark but have valid needs may still be assisted with ComCare on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The ComCare assistance rates are also regularly adjusted to ensure adequate support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The ComCare Short-to-Medium-Term assistance quantum accounts for projected inflation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For cost-of-living concerns, there is also support in other forms, such as the Assurance Package, which has been enhanced with additional cash, U-Save, service and conservancy charge rebates, and Community Development Council (CDC) vouchers over the years.

sections.label: Reviews of basic living needs
sections.summary: Reviews consider expenditure for basic living needs, projected inflation and views from social service professionals working with low-income families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: Our reviews take into consideration data on expenditure for basic living needs, projected inflation and also views from social service professionals who work closely with our low-income families.

sections.label: CDC vouchers and Cost-of-Living Payment
sections.summary: CDC vouchers of $500 will be brought forward to June 2026, and eligible Singaporeans can receive up to $400 to $600 in September 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: For example, CDC vouchers of $500 will be brought forward to June 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: The Cost-of-Living Special Payment has also been enhanced, and eligible Singaporeans can receive up to $400 to $600 in September 2026.
